title: Full production functional realisation: variational-consistency scaffold
statement: The current external three-component N-001 working branch is hash-pinned with a declared energy, executable residual, executable Hessian, real torus pairing, Class-II floor, projector convention, and a multi-field audit matrix. Independent Torch autodiff plus finite differences validate the declared-energy derivative and test DF[Psi](v)=<R[Psi],v>_R, DR[Psi]v=H[Psi]v, and real Hessian symmetry on zero, homogeneous, random, q0-shell, and Class-II-active fields. The scaffold records rather than conceals the current obstructions: the scalar energy nonlinearities are factor-two inconsistent with the residual under the frozen real pairing, and the Class-II energy uses cKK whereas residual uses cJK.
